canonicalization.coordinateIdentity: D3COORD- plus the SHA-256 of the coordinate payload. anchorId and courseId are inside that payload.
canonicalization.null: JSON null when an accepted field is absent. The key is present.
canonicalization.qualifications: A string becomes a one-element array. An array of strings is sorted. A string is not split. An absent field is null.
canonicalization.subjectArray: Never hashed as one subject and never collapsed into one string.
canonicalization.unitIdentity: SHA-256 of the unit payload. benchmarkIdentity and countingContextId are inside that payload.

codes.EMPTY_C: NOT_APPLICABLE EMPTY_DENOMINATOR, numerator 0, denominator 0, score null

failures.digestDrift: Option P calls D3_DIGEST_DRIFT an admission failure. The frozen counting contract still says SCORING_FAILURE. Neither emits a number. This candidate does not amend that file.

simultaneousCodes.rule: One applicable code is emitted. Two or more applicable codes suppress the quotient and leave emittedFailureCode null. This candidate does not invent an order.

failures.wholeItem: Any applicable failure code suppresses every key. No partial C and no numeric quotient.

groupPath.atomicCellSubject: atomicCells[].subject is not a coordinate source.
groupPath.polarity: groups[].countingScope.polarity when the key is present, otherwise null
groupPath.qualifications: groups[].countingScope.qualifications normalized by the Option P rule, otherwise null
groupPath.relationPredicate: groups[].countingScope.relationPredicate when the key is present, otherwise null
groupPath.scopeId: groups[].scopeId when the key is present, otherwise null
groupPath.subject: groups[].countingScope.materialSubject when the key is present, otherwise null
groupPath.when: decision is EQUIVALENT_SCOPED or ATOMIC_COMPARISON_DECOMPOSITION, or the contribution is already bound to an accepted groupId.

localSubjectScopedDistinct.conflict: Both subjects present and unequal: D3_LOCAL_SUBJECT_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED for the whole item.
localSubjectScopedDistinct.multiToken: Whitespace in the binding subject: D3_LOCAL_SUBJECT_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED. The clause is not hashed.
localSubjectScopedDistinct.nullContext: A null typeSubjectContext still allows one single-token binding subject.
localSubjectScopedDistinct.singleToken: A non-empty string with no whitespace. UNKNOWN is such a token and is not rewritten.
localSubjectScopedDistinct.subject: localSubjectBindings[].subject joined to carriers[] by memberId

qualificationScopedDistinct.subject: qualifiedPropositions[].subject
qualificationScopedDistinct.typeInferencePermitted: A prohibition. It is not a payload field. UNKNOWN is not replaced.

subjectScopedDistinct.discrepancy: A missing carrier subject, or unequal sets, fails the whole item with D3_MAP_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS. Neither source is preferred.
subjectScopedDistinct.repeatedToken: One coordinate per distinct token on that anchor.
subjectScopedDistinct.subject: each distinct string in semanticAnalysis.materialSubject

maslowCatalogue25.reasonShape: localSubjectBindings[].subject is a multi-token heading clause and typeSubjectContext is null
